types.name: polyester.ratelimit.v1.FailureReason
types.doc: FailureReason identifies why rate-limit evaluation rejected a request.

values.name: QUOTA_EXCEEDED
values.doc: The active weighted quota did not have enough capacity.

values.name: AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: The required rate-limit authority could not make a safe decision.

types.name: polyester.ratelimit.v1.LimiterScope
types.doc:
LimiterScope identifies the caller dimension that owns exhausted capacity.
 It never contains the caller's actual identifier.

values.name: CLIENT_IP
values.doc: The normalized client network address owns the capacity.

values.name: API_KEY
values.doc: The authenticated API key owns the capacity.

values.name: ACCOUNT
values.doc: The authenticated account owns the capacity.

values.name: SUBACCOUNT
values.doc: The selected subaccount owns the capacity.

values.name: CONNECTION
values.doc: The active realtime connection owns the capacity.

values.name: SERVICE
values.doc: The calling service owns the capacity.

values.name: REGION
values.doc: The serving region owns the capacity.

values.name: SYMBOL
values.doc: The trading or market-data symbol owns the capacity.

values.name: AUTH_SUBJECT
values.doc: A privacy-preserving normalized public authentication subject owns capacity.

types.name: polyester.ratelimit.v1.PolicyClass
types.doc: PolicyClass identifies the mutable quota family used for a decision.

values.name: AUTH_PUBLIC
values.doc: Public authentication operations.

values.name: TRADING_PLACE
values.doc: Trading order and trigger placement operations.

values.name: TRADING_CANCEL
values.doc: Trading order and trigger cancellation operations.

values.name: TRADING_READ
values.doc: Authenticated trading read operations.

values.name: ACCOUNT_ADMIN
values.doc: General account and subaccount administration operations.

values.name: PUBLIC_READ
values.doc: Public market-data and realtime read operations.

values.name: ACCOUNT_SECURITY
values.doc: MFA, recovery, API-key, policy, and security-control mutations.

values.name: DEPOSIT_CREATE
values.doc: Deposit-address creation that may call an upstream provider.

values.name: INTERNAL_TRANSFER
values.doc: Off-chain internal ledger transfer admission.

values.name: WITHDRAW_SUBMIT
values.doc: Chain or lifecycle withdraw submission.

values.name: WITHDRAW_VALIDATE
values.doc: Withdraw destination validation.

values.name: GUARD_SIGN
values.doc: Guard-signer wallet and protected-action operations.

values.name: SOCIAL_PROVIDER
values.doc: External social-provider work.

types.name: polyester.ratelimit.v1.RateLimitDetail
types.doc:
RateLimitDetail contains bounded, client-safe quota state for one rejected
 operation. Weight values use the operation registry's weighted request units.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Active weighted quota. Present for quota-exhaustion responses.

fields.name: remaining
fields.doc: Weighted capacity remaining when the request was rejected.

fields.name: retry_after_ms
fields.doc: Minimum relative delay before retrying, in milliseconds.

fields.name: policy_version
fields.doc: Policy version used for the decision, when available.

fields.name: operation_id
fields.doc: Stable operation identifier shared by all aliases of the same action.

fields.name: policy_class
fields.doc: Mutable quota family used for the decision.

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: Caller dimension that owns the exhausted capacity.

fields.name: refill_model
fields.doc: Refill behavior used by the active limiter.

types.name: polyester.ratelimit.v1.RefillModel
types.doc: RefillModel describes how exhausted capacity becomes available again.

values.name: CONTINUOUS
values.doc: Capacity refills continuously over the configured policy period.

values.name: FIXED_WINDOW
values.doc: Capacity resets at fixed window boundaries.

values.name: ROLLING_WINDOW
values.doc: Capacity is measured over a rolling time window.
